output.reason: The input_preparation stage spans independent model/shape, numeric/template, board/runtime/tool, and human-boundary/evidence concerns before SACG extraction. These inputs can be audited in parallel by specialist chip-design roles, then gated by a cross-layer evidence auditor to prevent contaminated or incomplete inputs from entering SACG construction.

handoff_rule.on_gap: Mark absent or ambiguous model/shape semantics as SACG extraction blockers; request user/case_adapter evidence instead of guessing.
handoff_rule.on_pass: Forward model_shape_report and SACG seed requirements to the cross-layer evidence gate for consistency aggregation.

subtasks.objective: Audit task_card and model_config for sufficient decoder-block, tensor shape, attention/head mapping, sequence length, operator ordering, residual path, and model-goal facts needed for SACG extraction without inventing missing semantics.
subtasks.title: Validate model-facing SACG inputs

handoff_rule.on_gap: Declare unsupported numeric modes, unbound parameters, or missing trusted templates as repair/backtrack boundaries before SACG extraction.
handoff_rule.on_pass: Forward numeric/template coverage and parameter binding evidence to the cross-layer evidence gate.

subtasks.objective: Audit numeric_policy, template_library, template_metadata, and design_space for supported quantization, parameter binding, trusted template coverage, and resource-risk assumptions consistent with a template-constrained accelerator flow.
subtasks.title: Validate numeric policy and template coverage

blocked_if: required_real_tool_evidence_check fails for required deployment claims
handoff_rule.on_gap: If real tool or board-interface evidence is unavailable, mark the specific missing capability or user evidence requirement; do not allow inferred board/runtime facts to seed SACG.
handoff_rule.on_pass: Forward board/runtime/tool evidence and unresolved evidence gaps to the cross-layer evidence gate.

subtasks.objective: Audit target_board_profile, tool_profile, tool_availability, tool_protocols, field_evidence, and sample/material indices for concrete DDR/AXI, address-map, runtime ABI, deployment, and executable tool evidence while blocking unsupported implementation claims.
subtasks.role: board runtime and tool evidence engineer
subtasks.title: Validate board, memory, runtime, and tool inputs

handoff_rule.on_gap: Block SACG extraction if approval requirements, forbidden actions, or checker contracts are ambiguous; require explicit boundary clarification or planned checker implementation.
handoff_rule.on_pass: Forward checker coverage, approval boundaries, and repair constraints to the cross-layer evidence gate.

subtasks.objective: Audit case_adapter acceptance/evidence_gates, human_agent_boundary, tool_protocols, and prepared_inputs errors for checker coverage, approval requirements, forbidden actions, and bounded repair/backtrack rules before any SACG extraction or downstream implementation decision.
subtasks.title: Validate checker plan and human-agent boundaries

blocked_if: any parallel_group 0 specialist reports unresolved blocker
handoff_rule.on_gap: Emit targeted retry/backtrack requests mapped to violated constraints and prevent downstream SACG extraction from consuming unverified or contaminated artifacts.
handoff_rule.on_pass: Promote only checker-supported input facts into the SACG extraction input contract and hand off to sacg_extraction.

subtasks.objective: Merge all specialist reports, check cross-layer consistency among model, numeric, template, board/runtime, tool, and human-boundary inputs, classify any blockers, and produce the final SACG-extraction readiness decision with exact repair or backtrack boundaries.
subtasks.title: Aggregate input audits and gate SACG extraction readiness
